faqData.question: What is the dress code?
faqData.answer: Guests are invited in pastel colors — soft, light tones such as blush pink, light blue, lavender, mint, and peach. We kindly ask that you stay within this palette so the celebration feels cohesive in photos.

faqData.question: May I bring a plus-one?
faqData.answer: Yes! If your invitation includes a plus-one, please include them in your RSVP so we can plan seating and meals accordingly.

faqData.question: Are children welcome?
faqData.answer: We love your little ones, but this will be an adults-only celebration. Thank you for making childcare arrangements.
